subject: prd/plan-new
statement: The planner shall record validation and projection duration as non-blocking measurements, separating local computation from tracker wait time where observable; elapsed time shall never change a validation, projection, or release verdict for otherwise identical semantic inputs and external outcomes.
fit_criterion: dogfood and 30-task fixture runs record both duration classes; injected local and tracker delay leave the semantic verdict unchanged; reports compare the measurements with the descriptive 5-second validation and 5-minute projection baselines without treating either baseline as pass/fail
